verdict: BLOCK: two P2 training provenance defects

findings.issue: Legacy trial_started validation entries lacking consumption records are not reconciled until after training and selection.
findings.fix: Fail closed on unreconciled legacy validation history before reading or evaluating training.

findings.issue: Training guard ignores stored content_hash and only compares overlapping intervals with matching contract IDs. Exact consumed bytes can be reused as training under another declared contract ID.
findings.fix: Reject matching train sha256 independently of contract identity, as consume_validation already does; retain overlap detection.

limitations: Synthetic software verification only; zero real datasets evaluated in this review
Calendar, availability, static cost and administrative provenance remain externally asserted
Claims and validation consumption local to one governed journal
Separate validation cohorts are not a compounded account
Final holdout remains locked; no qualification or execution approval
